title: Thai Green Curry with Coconut Rice
description: A flavorful Thai-inspired dish made with green curry paste, coconut milk, and fresh green chilies, served with fluffy coconut rice.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the green chilies and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the green curry paste and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk and vegetable broth, and bring to a simmer.
Add the fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 10-15 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Meanwhile, cook the coconut rice according to package instructions.
To serve, place a scoop of coconut rice on a plate, and spoon the green curry sauce over the top.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves and serve immediately.
Serve with additional green chilies and fish sauce on the side, if desired.
Adjust the seasoning as needed, and serve hot.
